original_evidence: Define the reference features and comparison order before a run.
Reconsider retained associations against subsequent evidence, releasing those that become contradictory; allow a record to remain associated with several groups.
Record matches, contradictions and missing evidence separately.
neutral_evidence: Before each run, define a fixed panel of documented reference features drawn from the draft and any available witnesses, and define the comparison order.
Reconsider retained associations against subsequent evidence and drop those that become contradictory.
Allow a record to remain associated with several groups.
Record matches, contradictions and missing evidence separately.
operation_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase preserves indexed units, manual comparison, predefined references and order, provisional matching, rejection, unresolved associations, reconsideration, multiple memberships and separate evidence records.

original_evidence: Observe whether records develop distinct, stable patterns of association with the fixed reference groups
Record which features retain each association, which comparisons release it, and which records remain overlapping or unresolved.
No particular separation result is assumed.
neutral_evidence: Whether records develop distinct, stable patterns of association with the fixed reference groups.
Which features sustain each association.
Which comparisons cause an association to be dropped.

signal_preserved.rationale: All association signals and unresolved outcomes remain observable without presupposing successful grouping. Multiple alteration records per passage and the nonchronological status of procedural observations are also preserved.

preferring sequences that explain the supported relations with fewer unsupported revision or assembly events
otherwise report a partial order and retain competing sequences.
neutral_evidence: A stable grouping would support the conclusion that there are distinguishable evidence profiles
Those profiles may be identified as revision or assembly contributions only where independent evidence supports that interpretation.

inference_preserved.rationale: The conditional progression from profiles to independently supported contributions remains intact. Both texts use the same available evidence to constrain temporal relations, apply the same sequence preference, distinguish narrative from composition order and retain alternatives when constraints do not discriminate.

original_evidence: their existence and separability are hypotheses.
Additional witnesses, dates and provenance are usable only if available and established.
Different contributions may share features and remain inseparable, while one contribution may vary internally and appear as several groups.
Group membership alone establishes neither a date, an author nor a revision stage, and a local alteration cannot establish the whole draft's history.
not a validated physical separation or calibrated chronology.
neutral_evidence: both their existence and their separability are hypotheses, not established facts.
Additional witnesses, dates and provenance are used only if they are available and established.
different contributions may share features and remain inseparable; one contribution may vary internally and appear as several groups
group membership alone establishes neither a date, an author nor a revision stage; a local alteration cannot establish the whole draft's history
not a validated separation method and not a calibrated chronology.
limit_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase retains hypothetical components, evidence availability conditions, nonspecific features, sensitivity to analytical choices, unresolved contributions and all negative inference limits. It also preserves the prohibition on counting repeated inspection as additional support and the qualitative, uncalibrated status of the procedure.

original_evidence: Repeat the comparisons until a full pass changes no associations, or until remaining distinctions require unavailable evidence.
If these checks are unavailable or inconclusive, stop at the supported partial order and name the unresolved relations.
neutral_evidence: Repeat the comparisons until a full pass changes no associations, or until remaining distinctions require unavailable evidence.
If those checks are unavailable or inconclusive, stop at the supported partial order and name the unresolved relations.
stopping_condition_preserved.rationale: Both comparison-cycle stopping conditions and the conditional stopping rule for inconclusive or unavailable follow-up checks are preserved.

original_evidence: Test dependence on those choices by repeating disputed comparisons with explicitly documented alternative boundaries or reference definitions, keeping each run's conditions fixed.
If a proposed sequence depends on an ambiguous grouping, seek additional witnesses, inspect relevant material features, or consult available dated correspondence and provenance.
neutral_evidence: Test dependence on reference selection, unit boundaries and comparison rules by repeating disputed comparisons with explicitly documented alternative boundaries or reference definitions, holding each run's conditions fixed.
If a proposed sequence depends on an ambiguous grouping, seek additional witnesses, inspect the relevant material features, or consult available dated correspondence and provenance.
next_inquiry_preserved.rationale: The dependence checks, fixed conditions within each run, trigger for further inquiry and available avenues of inquiry are unchanged. Stating that no further follow-up is specified accurately reflects the original's scope.

original_evidence: Make separately indexed records for these units, preserving their locations and relationships.
A stable separation would support distinguishable evidence profiles
Identify these profiles as revision or assembly contributions only where independent evidence supports that interpretation.
neutral_evidence: Each such unit gets a separately indexed record that preserves its location and its relationships to other units.

Two layers of result: (a) evidence profiles, meaning patterns of association with reference groups; (b) interpretation of profiles as revision or assembly contributions, conditional on independent evidence.
no_added_operational_content.rationale: The overview, numbered actions and decomposition reorganize existing content. They introduce no new operation, evidence source, decision threshold or inferential permission; explicit dependence observables and uncertainty reporting restate existing requirements.

original_evidence: This is a qualitative comparison procedure, not a validated physical separation or calibrated chronology.
neutral_evidence: The procedure is a qualitative comparison; it is not a validated separation method and not a calibrated chronology.
no_verdict_language.rationale: The paraphrase makes no claim about ordinariness, novelty, creativity, departure from practice or addition or absence of a new warrant. Its validation and chronology statements preserve methodological limits; the inferential_warrant field describes conditional inferences without evaluating their novelty.
